notes: The §1985:XIII.3.2.2 report-file FD admits BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD CONTAINS, LABEL {RECORD IS|RECORDS ARE} {STANDARD|OMITTED}, VALUE OF implementor-name-1 IS {data-name|literal}, [CODE-SET IS alphabet-name-1] and a required REPORT(S) clause, in any order (§1985:XIII.3.2.3 SR2), widened by the IPC Format 3 (§1985:X.4.2.3 SR3) with EXTERNAL/GLOBAL and RECORD VARYING. The grammar's fileDescriptionClause with the brace-exact labelRecordsClause and valueOfClause (kb/Work PB5070) parses it; FileDescriptionFormats.Rows decides Format 3 by the REPORT clause and FileDescriptionClauseAdmitted refuses LINAGE there (COBOL2604); VersionConformancePass refuses the 2002 CODE-SET FOR/alphabet-name-2 and the 2023 BYTES at 85 (COBOL0900). Probes at --std 85: a full clause set in reversed order (REPORT, GLOBAL, BLOCK 1 TO 2 RECORDS, RECORD 1 TO 80, LABEL RECORD IS STANDARD, VALUE OF with a literal and a data-name, CODE-SET) and RECORD IS VARYING ... DEPENDING ON ran (DONE); refused: LABEL RECORDS ARE IGNORED (the witness, COBOL5506), VALUE OF "lit" with no implementor-name (COBOL5506), LINAGE (COBOL2604), CODE-SET FOR ALPHANUMERIC and two alphabet-names (COBOL0900), RECORD ... BYTES (COBOL0900), a REPORT or LABEL clause written twice (COBOL2423), an 01 record after the FD (COBOL2578), REPORT on a RELATIVE file (COBOL2604), DATA RECORDS (COBOL6849, the data-name names no 01 of a report FD, which may have none).

next.reason: 1985 report-file FD: BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORD CONTAINS, LABEL RECORD(S) {STANDARD|OMITTED}, VALUE OF, CODE-SET, {REPORT IS|REPORTS ARE}. §2023:13.4.5.2 Format 3 (report), the report-file FD per §2023:13.4.5.3 SR8, keeps BLOCK (§2023:13.18.10.2), the record-clause (§2023:13.18.43.2), CODE-SET (§2023:13.18.13.2, adding FOR ALPHANUMERIC/NATIONAL) and REPORT (§2023:13.18.46.2) but has no LABEL or VALUE OF clause anywhere in the standard, so a 1985 report FD using them is refused. EXTERNAL/GLOBAL and RECORD VARYING are not new (1985 X.4.2.2 Format 3). CHANGED (stricter and looser).
